items.text: The universe (or fate, or life) is:

options.A: Fundamentally benevolent—things tend to work out
options.C: Fundamentally indifferent—no inherent favor or disfavor
options.D: Slightly hostile—you must work against resistance
options.E: Fundamentally hostile—you must struggle against it

items.text: "The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends toward justice." This is:

options.A: True—there is a positive direction to history
options.B: Probably true—progress is real despite setbacks
options.C: A hopeful belief, neither clearly true nor false
options.D: Probably false—history shows no clear direction
options.E: False—the universe is indifferent to justice

items.text: When bad things happen to good people, it shows that:

options.A: There's a larger plan we can't understand
options.B: Good and bad are not perfectly balanced but tend toward good
options.C: The universe is morally neutral—goodness doesn't guarantee good outcomes
options.D: Life is often unfair with no cosmic balance
options.E: The universe is indifferent or hostile to human welfare
